Established as a [[joint venture]] between [[ICICI Bank]] Limited{{cite web|title=Stock Share Price {{!}} Get Quote {{!}} BSE|url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/icici-bank-ltd/icicibank/532174/|access-date=2021-09-06|website=www.bseindia.com}} and [[Prudential plc|Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited]],{{cite web |title=ICICI Prudential Life climbs after tieup with NSDL Payments Bank |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/icici-prudential-life-climbs-after-tieup-with-nsdl-payments-bank-120091000536_1.html |website=Business Standard India |access-date=14 September 2020 |date=10 September 2020}} ICICI Prudential Life is engaged in life insurance and asset management business. In 2016, the company became the first insurance company in India to be listed in the domestic [[stock exchanges]].{{Cite news|title=ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/icici-pru-life-22005/information/company-history|access-date=2021-05-03}}{{cite web|date=2016-09-28|title=ICICI Prudential Life Insurance to debut on BSE, NSE tomorrow|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/icici-prudential-life-insurance-to-debut-on-bse-nse-tomorrow/395276/|access-date=2021-05-03|website=The Financial Express|language=en-US}} == History == ICICI Prudential Life Insurance started its operations in 2000. The life insurance arm was established as a joint venture between [[ICICI Bank|ICICI Bank Limited]] and [[Prudential plc|Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited]].{{cite news |title=Prudential Corp to sell up to 3.71% in ICICI Prudential Life Insurance |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/prudential-corp-to-sell-up-to-371-in-icici-prudential-life-insurance/article26635224.ece Prudential Life became the first insurance company to be listed in Indian stock exchanges, namely [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]].{{cite news extract: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited is an Indian life insurance company in India. Established as a joint venture between ICICI Bank Limited and Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited, ICICI Prudential Life is engaged in life insurance and asset management business. In 2016, the company became the first insurance company in India to be listed in the domestic stock exchanges.
